title: Encoding the zero vector
statement: Let $\ell$ be a nonnegative integer and $m$ a length-$\ell$ vector over $\mathbb F_2$. The encoding of the zero vector in the quotient obtained by adjoining a root of $X^\ell+\sum_{i<\ell}m_iX^i$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ is a length-$\ell$ vector over $\mathbb F_2$
